definitions.explanation: The side of something facing north, or the area to the north of a reference point. Often used for the side of a building, road, or region.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{北側|きたがわ}に{出口|でぐち}がある。
examples.english: There is an exit on the north side of the station.

examples.japanese: {北側|きたがわ}の{部屋|へや}は{日|ひ}があまり{当|あ}たらない。
examples.english: Rooms on the north side don't get much sunlight.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{北側|きたがわ}には{大|おお}きな{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: A large parking lot extends on the north side of the building.

notes:
Compound of {北|きた} (north) + {側|がわ} (side). Used for any north-facing side or location to the north. Frequently appears in real estate and direction-giving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅|えき}の{北側|きたがわ}: north side of the station
- {北側|きたがわ}の{窓|まど}: north-facing window
- {道|みち}の{北側|きたがわ}: north side of the road
- {北側|きたがわ}に{面|めん}する: to face north

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {南側|みなみがわ}: south side
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: east side
- {西側|にしがわ}: west side
- {北|きた}: north (the direction itself)
